exposure: estimated large for gestational age fetuses
Trial of labor after cesarean delivery
cohort: 1949 pregnant women with an estimated fetal weight ≥90th percentile for gestational age, admitted to a single tertiary care center between January 2012-July 2017 for TOLAC
finding: While the rate of obstetrical complications was comparable, women with estimated large for gestational age fetuses (≥90th percentile) had lower successful vaginal delivery rates and an increased rate of postpartum hemorrhage during TOLAC compared to controls.
mod_finding: While generally safe, trial of labor after cesarean delivery in women with estimated large for gestational age fetuses was associated with lower rates of successful vaginal delivery and increased postpartum hemorrhage rates.
